hints.title: Which regions are safe?
hints.body: Instead of finding enclosed regions directly, find the regions that can escape. Any `O` connected to a border `O` survives.

hints.title: Start at the border
hints.body: Run a flood fill from every border `O`, moving through orthogonal `O` neighbors. Mark all cells reached by these searches as safe.

hints.title: Flip the rest
hints.body: After marking safe cells, scan the copied board. Change an `O` to `X` only when it was not reached from the border. Leave every other cell as it is.
